title: 语法 · 语序与焦点｜强调、倒装和省略 · 60 句
description: 副词位置、强调结构、否定前置、直接与嵌入问句、平行结构及省略替代。

items.zh: 她通常在早餐后练唱，而不是一醒来就练。
items.en: She usually practises singing after breakfast rather than immediately on waking.
answers: She usually practises singing after breakfast rather than immediately on waking.
items.notes: 频率副词通常放实义动词前。

items.zh: 这家餐馆周末总是很热闹。
items.en: The restaurant is always busy at weekends.
answers: The restaurant is always busy at weekends.
items.notes: always 放在 be 动词后，形容词前。

items.zh: 我只在需要安静时才来这里。
items.en: I come here only when I need quiet.
answers: I come here only when I need quiet.
items.notes: only 靠近 when 从句，限定来访条件。

items.zh: 只有我妹妹知道聚会的地点。
items.en: Only my sister knows where the gathering is.
answers: Only my sister knows where the gathering is.
items.notes: only 放主语前，限定知道的人，不触发倒装。

items.zh: 我妹妹只知道聚会地点，不知道时间。
items.en: My sister knows only the location, not the time.
answers: My sister knows only the location, not the time.
items.notes: only 放宾语前，限定知道的信息。

items.zh: 我们甚至没有机会品尝自己做的菜。
items.en: We did not even get a chance to taste our own cooking.
answers: We did not even get a chance to taste our own cooking.
We didn't even get a chance to taste our own cooking.
items.notes: even 放否定后，强调连最基本机会都没有。

items.zh: 我已经把食物放进冰箱，但还没有贴日期。
items.en: I have already refrigerated the food but have not dated it yet.
answers: I have already refrigerated the food but have not dated it yet.
I have already refrigerated the food but haven't dated it yet.
items.notes: already 通常放助动词后；yet 常位于否定句末。

items.zh: 这件事几乎完全取决于天气。
items.en: It depends almost entirely on the weather.
answers: It depends almost entirely on the weather.
items.notes: almost 修饰 entirely，顺序体现程度层次。

items.zh: 她直接回答了问题，没有绕开重点。
items.en: She answered the question directly without avoiding the main point.
answers: She answered the question directly without avoiding the main point.
items.notes: 方式副词一般放宾语后，不拆开动词与短宾语。

items.zh: 他们也想参加，但不想负责组织。
items.en: They also want to attend, but not to organise.
answers: They also want to attend, but not to organise.
items.notes: also 位于实义动词前；后半省略可恢复的 they want。

items.zh: 让我改变主意的是那次谈话，而不是广告。
items.en: It was the conversation, not the advertisement, that changed my mind.
answers: It was the conversation, not the advertisement, that changed my mind.
items.notes: it was ... that 强调主语，去掉强调框架仍成完整句。

items.zh: 我最欣赏的是她愿意承认错误。
items.en: What I admire most is her willingness to admit mistakes.
answers: What I admire most is her willingness to admit mistakes.
items.notes: what 引导伪分裂句主语，把新信息放表语位置。

items.zh: 我们是在旅程结束以后才知道这件事的。
items.en: It was after the journey that we learned about it.
answers: It was after the journey that we learned about it.
items.notes: 强调时间短语，不把 that 误写为 when。

items.zh: 我想要的不是退款，而是一个解释。
items.en: What I want is an explanation rather than a refund.
answers: What I want is an explanation rather than a refund.
items.notes: what 主语从句聚焦所需对象。

items.zh: 正是因为座位太少，大家才站在走廊上。
items.en: It is because there are too few seats that people stand in the corridor.
answers: It is because there are too few seats that people stand in the corridor.
items.notes: 强调 because 原因从句，用 that 收束。

items.zh: 真正让人疲惫的是噪声，不是距离。
items.en: It is the noise, not the distance, that makes the trip tiring.
answers: It is the noise, not the distance, that makes the trip tiring.
items.notes: 被强调主语 noise 单数，makes 与其一致。

items.zh: 我们所做的只是给客人提供另一种选择。
items.en: All we did was offer guests another option.
answers: All we did was offer guests another option.
items.notes: all we did was 后可用原形 offer，强调行为范围有限。

items.zh: 我确实很感谢你的邀请。
items.en: I do appreciate your invitation.
answers: I do appreciate your invitation.
items.notes: do + 原形强调肯定，不表示一般疑问。

items.zh: 这份甜点最特别的地方在于它温热的夹心。
items.en: What makes the dessert special is its warm filling.
answers: What makes the dessert special is its warm filling.
items.notes: what 从句作主语，焦点在 filling。

items.zh: 邀请他的是主办方，不是我。
items.en: It was the organiser who invited him, not me.
answers: It was the organiser who invited him, not me.
items.notes: 强调人时可用 who；not me 对照被强调成分。

items.zh: 我以前从未在露天看过这样的演出。
items.en: Never before have I seen a performance like this outdoors.
answers: Never before have I seen a performance like this outdoors.
items.notes: 否定状语 never before 置首，助动词提前。

items.zh: 只有坐下来以后，我才发觉自己有多累。
items.en: Only after I sat down did I realise how tired I was.
answers: Only after I sat down did I realise how tired I was.
items.notes: only + 状语置首，主句倒装，从句不倒装。

items.zh: 她很少把陌生人的沉默当成不友好。
items.en: Rarely does she interpret a stranger's silence as hostility.
answers: Rarely does she interpret a stranger's silence as hostility.
items.notes: rarely 前置，补 does，interpret 用原形。

items.zh: 任何时候都不应让儿童独自靠近水边。
items.en: At no time should children approach the water alone.
answers: At no time should children approach the water alone.
items.notes: at no time 为否定状语，情态动词提前。

items.zh: 我们直到账单送来才发现服务费已包含在内。
items.en: Not until the bill arrived did we realise the service charge was included.
answers: Not until the bill arrived did we realise the service charge was included.
items.notes: not until 从句保持正常语序，主句用 did 倒装。

items.zh: 他不仅会演奏，还会自己修理乐器。
items.en: Not only does he perform, but he also repairs his instruments.
answers: Not only does he perform, but he also repairs his instruments.
items.notes: not only 引导分句前置倒装；but also 后不倒装。

items.zh: 我完全没有怀疑过她的诚意。
items.en: At no point did I question her sincerity.
answers: At no point did I question her sincerity.
items.notes: at no point 前置，使用 did + 主语 + 原形。

items.zh: 只有通过交谈，我们才能发现彼此不同的期待。
items.en: Only through conversation can we discover our different expectations.
answers: Only through conversation can we discover our different expectations.
items.notes: only + 介词短语置首，can 提前。

items.zh: 我绝不会在没有说明的情况下取消约定。
items.en: Under no circumstances would I cancel an arrangement without explanation.
answers: Under no circumstances would I cancel an arrangement without explanation.
items.notes: 否定介词短语前置触发倒装。

items.zh: 我那时不知道，这首歌会成为全场最受欢迎的一首。
items.en: Little did I know that the song would become the audience's favourite.
answers: Little did I know that the song would become the audience's favourite.
items.notes: little 表几乎不知道，前置后用 did 倒装。

items.zh: 是谁决定把晚餐搬到室外的？
items.en: Who decided to move dinner outdoors?
answers: Who decided to move dinner outdoors?
items.notes: who 作主语，不加 did。

items.zh: 你把给老师的卡片交给谁了？
items.en: Who did you give the card for the teacher to?
answers: Who did you give the card for the teacher to?
items.notes: who 作介词宾语，主句用 did；to 留在句尾。

items.zh: 你觉得哪种菜最适合第一次尝试的人？
items.en: Which dish do you think suits a first-time visitor best?
answers: Which dish do you think suits a first-time visitor best?
items.notes: which dish 是 suits 的主语，不在从句再加 does。

items.zh: 你为什么没告诉我们票价已经改变？
items.en: Why did you not tell us the fare had changed?
answers: Why did you not tell us the fare had changed?
items.notes: 疑问句 did 提前，tell 用原形。

items.zh: 除了主持人，还有谁知道结果？
items.en: Who else knows the result apart from the host?
answers: Who else knows the result apart from the host?
items.notes: who else 作主语，knows 单数。

items.zh: 能告诉我最近的饮水点在哪里吗？
items.en: Can you tell me where the nearest drinking-water point is?
answers: Can you tell me where the nearest drinking-water point is?
items.notes: 嵌入问句用 where ... is，不用 where is。

items.zh: 要到什么时候我们才能知道有没有空位？
items.en: When will we know whether any places are available?
answers: When will we know whether any places are available?
items.notes: 外层 when 疑问倒装，内层 whether 陈述语序。

items.zh: 你是想在这里等，还是想先去散步？
items.en: Would you prefer to wait here or go for a walk first?
answers: Would you prefer to wait here or go for a walk first?
items.notes: 选择问句共享 prefer to，or 后不必重复。

items.zh: 为什么不让每个人各带一道菜呢？
items.en: Why not let everyone bring a dish?
answers: Why not let everyone bring a dish?
items.notes: why not 后接原形，表示建议。

items.zh: 还有什么是我们出发前需要知道的？
items.en: What else do we need to know before setting out?
answers: What else do we need to know before setting out?
items.notes: what else 为 know 的宾语；do 提前构成疑问。

items.zh: 好的向导既会观察，也会倾听。
items.en: A good guide both observes and listens.
answers: A good guide both observes and listens.
items.notes: both ... and ... 连接相同词性动词。

items.zh: 我们可以提前离开，也可以接受等到傍晚。
items.en: We can either leave early or wait until dusk.
answers: We can either leave early or wait until dusk.
items.notes: either ... or ... 连接两个原形动词。

items.zh: 这次讨论关注怎样参与、怎样提问和怎样回应。
items.en: The discussion concerns how to participate, ask questions and respond.
answers: The discussion concerns how to participate, ask questions and respond.
items.notes: 三个动词共享 how to，保持平行结构。

items.zh: 她喜欢旅行中的交谈、观察和记录。
items.en: She enjoys talking, observing and keeping notes while travelling.
answers: She enjoys talking, observing and keeping notes while travelling.
items.notes: enjoys 后三个并列动名词形式一致。

items.zh: 问题不在于缺少想法，而在于缺少落实的时间。
items.en: The problem is not a lack of ideas but a lack of time to act on them.
answers: The problem is not a lack of ideas but a lack of time to act on them.
The problem isn't a lack of ideas but a lack of time to act on them.
items.notes: not ... but ... 两端为平行名词短语。

items.zh: 我们既没有催促孩子，也没有替他们完成任务。
items.en: We neither rushed the children nor completed the task for them.
answers: We neither rushed the children nor completed the task for them.
items.notes: neither ... nor ... 并列同类谓语动作。

items.zh: 她希望饭菜简单、分量充足，而且容易分享。
items.en: She wants the food to be simple, plentiful and easy to share.
answers: She wants the food to be simple, plentiful and easy to share.
items.notes: 并列形容词作补足，第三项可为形容词短语。

items.zh: 我愿意帮忙准备，却不愿负责主持。
items.en: I am willing to help prepare but unwilling to host.
answers: I am willing to help prepare but unwilling to host.
items.notes: willing 与 unwilling 平行，第二项省略 I am。

items.zh: 组织者既要解释规则，也要听取异议。
items.en: Organisers need to explain the rules as well as listen to objections.
answers: Organisers need to explain the rules as well as listen to objections.
items.notes: as well as 连接同级动作，两边形式对应。

items.zh: 我们想知道谁受益、谁付款，以及谁作决定。
items.en: We want to know who benefits, who pays and who decides.
answers: We want to know who benefits, who pays and who decides.
items.notes: 三个 who 从句平行作宾语。

items.zh: 我以为她会拒绝，但她没有。
items.en: I thought she would refuse, but she did not.
answers: I thought she would refuse, but she did not.
I thought she would refuse, but she didn't.
items.notes: did not 替代重复的 refuse，不重复整个动作。

items.zh: 你喜欢热闹的聚会，他也一样。
items.en: You enjoy lively gatherings, and so does he.
answers: You enjoy lively gatherings, and so does he.
items.notes: so + 助动词 + 主语 表另一人也如此，does 对应 enjoys。

items.zh: 我不会滑冰，她也不会。
items.en: I cannot skate, and neither can she.
answers: I cannot skate, and neither can she.
I can't skate, and neither can she.
items.notes: neither + 情态动词 + 主语，承接否定。

items.zh: 他们打算留下来吃饭，我们也打算这样做。
items.en: They plan to stay for dinner, and we plan to do so too.
answers: They plan to stay for dinner, and we plan to do so too.
items.notes: do so 替代 stay for dinner 的行为。

items.zh: 还会有空位吗？我希望有，但不能确定。
items.en: Will there be seats left? I hope so, but I cannot be certain.
answers: Will there be seats left? I hope so, but I cannot be certain.
Will there be seats left? I hope so, but I can't be certain.
items.notes: so 替代前问中的肯定命题 there will be seats left。

items.zh: 如果有需要，我们可以把桌子移开。
items.en: If necessary, we can move the table aside.
answers: If necessary, we can move the table aside.
items.notes: if necessary 省略 if it is necessary。

items.zh: 只要可能，她都会走路去拜访朋友。
items.en: Whenever possible, she walks to visit friends.
answers: Whenever possible, she walks to visit friends.
items.notes: whenever possible 为省略结构。

items.zh: 想吃什么就拿什么，但别拿超过你能吃完的量。
items.en: Take what you want, but no more than you can finish.
answers: Take what you want, but no more than you can finish.
items.notes: 后半省略 take，保持可恢复性。

items.zh: 他答应过来，也确实来了。
items.en: He promised to come, and he did.
answers: He promised to come, and he did.
items.notes: did 代替 came，表示行为兑现。

items.zh: 我不愿意在忙乱时作决定，所以只要能等，我就会等。
items.en: I prefer not to decide in a rush, so I wait whenever I can.
answers: I prefer not to decide in a rush, so I wait whenever I can.
items.notes: whenever I can 省略 wait，内容由前面的 I wait 明确恢复。
